Ragas.installation_notes: Heavy transitive dependency tree (LangChain, datasets, pyarrow, openai) timed out during package resolution/download in isolated environment.

retrieval_miss.evidence: Uses continuous metric 'context_recall' (0.0-1.0). Low recall indicates missing evidence, but does not distinguish omission from corpus vs retrieval failure.

ranking_miss.evidence: Uses continuous metric 'context_precision'. Measures whether relevant items appear earlier, but cannot verify whether gold chunk fell just outside top-k context window.

generation_ignored_context.evidence: Uses 'faithfulness' metric. Measures if answer claims are entailed by context; indicates ungroundedness but lacks discrete root-cause attribution.

should_abstain.evidence: No native abstention metric for unanswerable queries; evaluates context relevancy and faithfulness against non-existent evidence, yielding misleading scores.

PyVectorHound.installation_notes: PyPI wheel is corrupted: contains only a .pth file hardcoded to author's local drive (/Users/georgimullassery/pyvectorhound) and zero Python modules.

retrieval_miss.evidence: Core Rust engine computes embedding isotropy, vector coverage, and recall against expected docs in vector DB.

ranking_miss.evidence: Calculates MRR/NDCG on candidate pool, but reranker diagnostics are explicitly documented as UNKNOWN / Not Implemented.

generation_ignored_context.evidence: Explicitly scoped exclusively to retrieval; does not inspect LLM generation, prompt context utilization, or text generation errors.

should_abstain.evidence: Has no concept of query unanswerability or model refusal/abstention.

DeepDiag_RAGDiag.installation_notes: Interactive Streamlit application hardcoded to 306 legal chunks of the EU AI Act; not a reusable Python library or CLI.

retrieval_miss.evidence: Classifies errors coarsely into 'Retrieval-bound' (~28%); lumps all retrieval and ranking failures together.

ranking_miss.evidence: Does not differentiate between candidates excluded from the search pool vs candidates excluded by top-k truncation.

generation_ignored_context.evidence: Classifies errors into 'Generation-bound' (~26%) if gold chunk is retrieved but answer is unfaithful.

should_abstain.evidence: Assumes all queries are answerable legal questions; no abstention detection.

RAG_Oracle.installation_notes: Research ablation methodology (manually supplying gold context to measure generation ceiling) rather than a software tool.

retrieval_miss.evidence: If Oracle RAG succeeds while standard RAG fails, attributes failure to retrieval, but cannot diagnose why retrieval failed.

ranking_miss.evidence: Oracle substitution bypasses ranking entirely, providing zero diagnostic signal on rank truncation.

generation_ignored_context.evidence: If Oracle RAG also fails with gold context present, attributes failure to generation.

should_abstain.evidence: Undefined on unanswerable queries where no gold chunk exists to inject.
